sentences.en: There's a reason why I'm sharing my favorite Katie Mingle story with you.
sentences.zh: 我与大家分享我最喜欢的凯蒂·明格尔的故事，是有原因的。

sentences.en: And if you absolutely can't wait to find out that reason, skip ahead 25 minutes or so.
sentences.zh: 如果你绝对等不及想知道原因，可以把进度条快进25分钟左右。

sentences.en: But it would be cooler if we just took this walk together.
sentences.zh: 不过，如果我们能一起走完这段路，那就更酷了。

sentences.en: When producer Katie Mingle's dad retired, he began walking.
sentences.zh: 当制作人凯蒂·明格尔的父亲退休后，他开始散步。
他一直都是个爱走路的人。

sentences.en: But with all the new time on his hands, his walking took on a Forrest Gumpian fervor.
sentences.zh: 但有了大把空闲时间后，他的散步带上了一种《阿甘正传》般的狂热。

sentences.en: He started doing these really long, multi-day treks through the countryside.
sentences.zh: 他开始在乡间进行那些真正漫长、历时数天的徒步旅行。

sentences.en: And even though he's American, he mostly preferred to walk in the UK.
sentences.zh: 尽管他是美国人，但他大部分时间更喜欢在英国散步。

sentences.en: In fact, over the course of several years, he walked the entire length of Great Britain.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在几年时间里，他走完了整个英国的长度。

sentences.en: And on one of these many trips in 2003.
sentences.zh: 在2003年的众多旅行之一中。

sentences.en: I was walking through this beautiful, rolling hills and wooded area.
sentences.zh: 我当时正走在美丽起伏的山丘和林地间。

sentences.en: And there were just literally hundreds and hundreds of pheasants and grouse along this trail.
sentences.zh: 这条小径旁简直有成百上千只野鸡和松鸡。

sentences.en: And you'd walk along and they would fly up in the air.
sentences.zh: 你走着走着，它们就会腾空飞起。
那是我父亲，吉姆·明格尔。

sentences.en: I walked and walked and it got later and later and I realized I couldn't get back to my B&B where I was staying.
sentences.zh: 我走啊走，天色越来越晚，我意识到自己无法回到我住的B&B民宿了。

sentences.en: So I decided I would hitchhike back.
sentences.zh: 所以我决定搭便车回去。

sentences.en: Hitchhiking is dangerous, Dad, but go on.
sentences.zh: 搭便车很危险，爸爸，但你接着说。

sentences.en: I stuck out my thumb and up pulled this jeep.
sentences.zh: 我伸出大拇指，这辆吉普车停了下来。

sentences.en: And I hopped in and there was this guy sitting there, all dressed in sort of traditional tweed outfit with a funny cap.
sentences.zh: 我跳上车，里面坐着一个男人，穿着传统的花呢衣服，戴着一顶滑稽的帽子。

sentences.en: And there was a shotgun on the rack in the back, which you never, ever saw in Britain.
sentences.zh: 后排的架子上还有一把猎枪，这在英国是绝对、绝对见不到的。

sentences.en: And we got to talking and he said he was the gamekeeper for Madonna and Guy Ritchie.
sentences.zh: 我们聊了起来，他说他是麦当娜和盖·里奇的看守人。

sentences.en: My dad had been walking through Madonna's private estate when he was picked up by her gamekeeper.
sentences.zh: 我父亲在穿过麦当娜的私人庄园时，被她的庄园看守人顺车载了一程。

sentences.en: Which is a thing a lot of wealthy landowners have in England.
sentences.zh: 这是英国许多富有地主都会做的事。

sentences.en: A person who manages the hunting activity on their land.
sentences.zh: 一个管理他们土地上狩猎活动的人。

sentences.en: So this gamekeeper drove him back to the village where he was staying and dropped him off.
sentences.zh: 所以这个看守人把他开车送回了他住的村庄，并把他放下。

sentences.en: And no, his story doesn't end with him meeting Madonna.
sentences.zh: 不，他的故事并没有以见到麦当娜而告终。

sentences.en: And I ask about Madonna, how he liked, this gamekeeper liked working for her.
sentences.zh: 我问起麦当娜，问他感觉如何，这个看守人喜欢为她工作吗。

sentences.en: And he said he loved his job and he thought Madonna was just wonderful.
sentences.zh: 他说他热爱自己的工作，并认为麦当娜非常棒。

sentences.en: What's your favorite Madonna song, Dad?
sentences.zh: 爸爸，你最喜欢的麦当娜歌曲是什么？

sentences.en: I just like the idea of Madonna.
sentences.zh: 我只是喜欢麦当娜这个概念。

sentences.en: I'm not very good at remembering those kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 我不太擅长记住那种事情。

sentences.en: Now that we've established that Madonna is wonderful and my dad can't name a single one of her songs,
sentences.zh: 既然我们已经确定了麦当娜很棒，而我父亲一首她的歌也说不出来，

sentences.en: you might be asking yourself, as I was,
sentences.zh: 你可能会问自己，就像我当时一样：

sentences.en: Dad, what were you doing in Madonna's backyard?
sentences.zh: 爸爸，你在麦当娜的后院里干什么？

sentences.en: I was walking most of the time across private property.
sentences.zh: 我大部分时间都在私人土地上行走。

sentences.en: I was walking from one field to the next,
sentences.zh: 我从一个田地走到另一个田地，

sentences.en: climbing over the fence or through a gate and going on.
sentences.zh: 翻过栅栏或穿过大门继续前行。

sentences.en: My dad walked the length of Great Britain and was on private property a lot of the time,
sentences.zh: 我父亲走遍了整个英国，大部分时间都在私人土地上，

sentences.en: which is different, obviously, than the way we do things in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这显然与我们在美国的行事方式不同。

sentences.en: If you wanted to walk across this country,
sentences.zh: 如果你想穿过这个国家，

sentences.en: you'd have to do it on a combination of public trails and roads.
sentences.zh: 你必须通过公共小径和道路的组合来实现。

sentences.en: And you certainly couldn't cut across Madonna's property.
sentences.zh: 而且你肯定不能直接抄近路穿过麦当娜的房产。

sentences.en: This right in Britain to walk through private land is known colloquially as the right to roam.
sentences.zh: 在英国，这种在私人土地上行走的权利俗称“漫游权”。

sentences.en: And the movement to win this right was started in the 1930s
sentences.zh: 争取这一权利的运动始于20世纪30年代，

sentences.en: by a rebellious group of young people dressed in army surplus shorts and hiking boots,
sentences.zh: 由一群身穿军队闲置短裤和徒步靴、

sentences.en: carrying canvas and rucksacks and canteens.
sentences.zh: 背着帆布背包、携带水壶的叛逆年轻人发起。

sentences.en: Rambler is one of those quaint old English words.
sentences.zh: “漫步者”是英国那些古雅的旧词之一。

sentences.en: I don't know where it came from, really, but it means walking or hiking in the countryside.
sentences.zh: 我不知道它究竟从何而来，但它的意思是在乡间散步或徒步旅行。

sentences.en: This is Rolly Smith, a rambler slash journalist,
sentences.zh: 这是罗利·史密斯，一位漫步者兼记者，

sentences.en: who says his rambling forefathers and mothers were toiling away in the factories of 1930s Manchester.
sentences.zh: 他说他的漫步者先辈们曾在20世纪30年代曼彻斯特的工厂里辛苦劳作。

sentences.en: Manchester was a very grimy town, a very dirty, smoky, horrible environment,
sentences.zh: 曼彻斯特是一个非常污浊的小镇，一个非常肮脏、烟雾弥漫、糟糕透顶的环境，

sentences.en: a product, really, of the Industrial Revolution.
sentences.zh: 说实话，这就是工业革命的产物。

sentences.en: Outside Manchester was one of the most beautiful parts of England,
sentences.zh: 曼彻斯特郊外是英格兰最美丽的地区之一，

sentences.en: an area known as the Peak District.
sentences.zh: 一个被称为峰区的地方。

sentences.en: So if you can imagine, factory workers in Manchester and Sheffield
sentences.zh: 所以你可以想象，曼彻斯特和谢菲尔德的工厂工人

sentences.en: could actually see these inviting moors from their homes and their workplaces,
sentences.zh: 其实从他们的家和工作场所就能看到这些诱人的荒原，

sentences.en: and they weren't allowed to walk on them.
sentences.zh: 但他们却不被允许在上面行走。

sentences.en: It hadn't always been this way.
For hundreds of years, an idea of the Commons had existed in England.
sentences.zh: 几百年来，英格兰一直存在着“公地”的概念。

sentences.en: So the Commons, they were an integral part of medieval life for the ordinary villager in England.
sentences.zh: 因此，公地是英格兰普通村民中世纪生活不可或缺的一部分。

sentences.en: That's Ken Ilgunas, author of This Land is Your Land,
sentences.zh: 这是肯·伊尔古纳斯，《这片土地是你的土地：

sentences.en: How We Lost the Right to Rome, and How to Take It Back.
sentences.zh: 我们是如何失去漫游权的，以及如何将其夺回》一书的作者。

sentences.en: All the land, it was owned by either a king or a lord,
sentences.zh: 所有的土地要么属于国王，要么属于领主，

sentences.en: but the peasants had very substantial and real rights on these common lands.
sentences.zh: 但农民在这些公地上拥有非常实质和真实的权利。

sentences.en: In this feudal system, kings and lords controlled all the land,
sentences.zh: 在这个封建制度中，国王和领主控制着所有的土地，

sentences.en: and the manor grew enough food to support itself and its tenants.
sentences.zh: 庄园生产足够的食物来养活自己和佃农。

sentences.en: The peasants lived on the land, sometimes without written leases,
sentences.zh: 农民们在这片土地上生活，有时没有书面租约，

sentences.en: but with assumed rights to use it in exchange for various types of service.
sentences.zh: 但享有以各种劳务为交换条件使用土地的既定权利。

sentences.en: They could graze their cattle, cut lumber, they could draw water, they could collect peat.
sentences.zh: 他们可以放牧牛群、砍伐木材、可以取水、可以收集泥炭。

sentences.en: They could use it for a whole bunch of purposes.
sentences.zh: 他们可以将其用于各种各样的目的。

sentences.en: All of that began to change in the 1400s, when wool prices rose across Europe.
sentences.zh: 这一切在15世纪开始改变，当时全欧洲的羊毛价格上涨。

sentences.en: Landowners wanted in on the profits, and in order to graze sheep more efficiently,
sentences.zh: 土地所有者想要分一杯羹，为了更有效地放牧绵羊，

sentences.en: they needed to fence off pastures.
sentences.zh: 他们需要用栅栏把牧场围起来。

sentences.en: And that's when we began to see a period of enclosure.
sentences.zh: 正是在那个时候，我们开始看到一个圈地时期。

sentences.en: Landowners cleared entire villages of people, making them homeless,
sentences.zh: 土地所有者将整个村庄的人驱逐，让他们无家可归，

sentences.en: and put up little stone walls and hedges to mark the boundaries of their property.
sentences.zh: 并竖起小石墙和树篱来标出他们财产的边界。

sentences.en: In a county called Warwickshire, 61 villages were wiped out before the year 1500.
sentences.zh: 在一个叫做沃里克郡的郡，在1500年之前就有61个村庄被消灭。

sentences.en: Over the years, parliament created more and more laws
sentences.zh: 多年来，议会制定了越来越多的法律，

sentences.en: to keep people from using what was once common land.
sentences.zh: 以阻止人们使用曾经的公地。

sentences.en: It all ramped up in the 1700s.
sentences.zh: 这一切在18世纪愈演愈烈。

sentences.en: There was nearly 4,000 acts of parliament between 1760 and 1870.
sentences.zh: 在1760年至1870年间，通过了近4000项议会法案。

sentences.en: That's a sixth of England that went from common lands to enclosed private property,
sentences.zh: 这使得英格兰六分之一的土地从公地变成了封闭的私有财产，

sentences.en: destroying people's livelihoods and way of life.
sentences.zh: 摧毁了人们的生计和生活方式。

sentences.en: People were so desperate to continue hunting on this once common land
sentences.zh: 人们为了继续在这片曾经的公地上打猎，已经到了不顾一切的地步，

sentences.en: that they came at night and covered their faces in soot for extra camouflage.
sentences.zh: 以至于他们在夜间到来，把脸涂上煤灰作为额外的伪装。

sentences.en: They became known as the Blacks.
And in 1723, parliament passed the Black Act.
So this Black Act, it created 50 offenses that were punishable by death
sentences.zh: 因此，这部《反黑森林法》针对进入这片土地的人，

sentences.en: for people who were accessing this land.
sentences.zh: 设立了50项可判处死刑的罪行。

sentences.en: Eventually, the death penalty for trespassing was done away with,
sentences.zh: 最终，私闯民宅的死刑被废除了，

sentences.en: but the land remained closed to the vast majority of people.
sentences.zh: 但绝大多数人依然被禁止进入这片土地。
在19世纪，英国实现了工业化，

sentences.en: and people found themselves indoors all day
sentences.zh: 人们发现自己整天呆在室内，

sentences.en: and unable to find places for recreation.
England did not have a national park system at this time,
sentences.zh: 当时英国还没有国家公园系统，

sentences.en: and the trails that people could access were extremely limited.
sentences.zh: 人们能够进入的小径极其有限。

sentences.en: Still, the people longed to be in the hills.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，人们仍然渴望置身于群山之中。

sentences.en: They walked where they could and trespassed where they couldn't.
sentences.zh: 他们能在哪里走就在哪里走，不能走的地方就硬闯。

sentences.en: They climbed over fences and tried to stay hidden from the gamekeepers.
sentences.zh: 他们翻过栅栏，试图躲避庄园看守人的视线。

sentences.en: And all over England, so-called rambling clubs started to form.
sentences.zh: 全英各地开始成立所谓的漫步俱乐部。

sentences.en: The Forest Ramblers Club, the Midlands Institute of Ramblers,
sentences.zh: 森林漫步者俱乐部、米德兰兹漫步者学会、

sentences.en: There were tons of these walking groups in the late 1800s and early 1900s
sentences.zh: 在19世纪末和20世纪初，有大量的这类徒步团体

sentences.en: forming to fight for access and walking rights.
sentences.zh: 成立起来，为争取通行权和步行权而战。
他们往往带有社会主义情怀，

sentences.en: but at the heart, there was a love for walking
sentences.zh: 但其核心是对步行的热爱，

sentences.en: and a belief that it was their right.
sentences.zh: 以及坚信这是他们的权利。

sentences.en: Access was no longer a matter of survival
sentences.zh: 通行权不再是一个生存问题，

sentences.en: as it had been in the days when enclosure began.
sentences.zh: 就像圈地运动开始时那样。

sentences.en: and getting away from the polluted industrial cities.
sentences.zh: 以及远离受污染的工业城市。

sentences.en: Which brings us back to polluted industrial 1930s Manchester
sentences.zh: 这就把我们带回了受污染的工业化1930年代的曼彻斯特，

sentences.en: and a rambling club called the British Workers' Sports Federation.
sentences.zh: 以及一个名为“英国工人体育联合会”的漫步俱乐部。

sentences.en: And in this group was a charismatic rambler named Benny Rothman.
sentences.zh: 这个团体中有一位极具个人魅力的漫步者，名叫本尼·罗斯曼。

sentences.en: A stocky little character, a very broad grin and a great sense of humour.
sentences.zh: 一个矮壮的小伙子，笑容灿烂，极具幽默感。

sentences.en: And a man of the highest principles.
sentences.zh: 一个拥有最高原则的人。

sentences.en: He was about five foot nothing, as we say.
sentences.zh: 用我们的话说，他大概只有五英尺零几英寸（不到1.5米）。

sentences.en: Rowley actually got to know Benny later in life.
sentences.zh: 罗利后来确实结识了晚年的本尼。

sentences.en: He was a man who I very much looked up to, although he was very short.
sentences.zh: 他是一个我非常敬仰的人，尽管他个子很矮。

sentences.en: So one day back in 1932, a few people from Benny's group
sentences.zh: 所以在1932年的某一天，本尼团队的几个人

sentences.en: tried to take a walk in the hills near Manchester.
sentences.zh: 试图去曼彻斯特附近的山丘散步。

sentences.en: In that beautiful mountainous area near the city called the Peak District.
sentences.zh: 在城市附近那个美丽的山区，被称为峰区。

sentences.en: And they were chased off by a group of gamekeepers.
sentences.zh: 结果他们被一群看守人赶走了。

sentences.en: And when they got back to their camp,

sentences.zh: 本尼·罗斯曼和其他人说：

sentences.en: you know, if there was enough of us, they couldn't stop us.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果我们人够多，他们就拦不住我们。

sentences.en: So Benny and the other ramblers came up with an idea.
sentences.zh: 于是本尼和其他漫步者想出了一个主意。

sentences.en: Let's get a huge group together
sentences.zh: 让我们组织一个庞大的群体，

sentences.en: and walk onto this mountain called Kinder Scout.
sentences.zh: 走到这座名叫金德斯考特的山上。

sentences.en: Which was the biggest mountain in this Peak District.
It was called the Forbidden Mountain.
And this area, this was guarded by a whole bunch of gamekeepers.
sentences.zh: 而这个区域，有大批的庄园看守人在把守。

sentences.en: I mean, they would use telescopes to identify trespassers from afar.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们会用望远镜从远处辨认私闯者。

sentences.en: They carried these big sticks or clubs that they would sometimes use on trespassers.
sentences.zh: 他们带着大棍子或大棒，有时会用这些对付私闯者。

sentences.en: The British Workers' Sports Federation did not keep their plans to trespass a secret.
sentences.zh: 英国工人体育联合会并没有对他们私闯的计划保密。

sentences.en: They gave an interview to the local paper saying,
sentences.zh: 他们接受了当地报纸的采访，并表示：

sentences.en: we feel we cannot any longer submit to being deprived of the beauties of the countryside
sentences.zh: 我们觉得不能再继续忍受被剥夺欣赏乡村美景的权利

sentences.en: for the convenience of the landowners.
Wherever we claim we have a just right to go,
sentences.zh: 无论我们声称自己有正当权利去往何处，
我们都要进行大规模的群聚闯入。

sentences.en: And Sunday will be the opening of our campaign.
sentences.zh: 而星期天将是我们这场运动的开端。
并非所有人都赞同这一做法。

sentences.en: More conservative rambling groups in the area wrote editorials denouncing their plan,
sentences.zh: 该地区一些较为保守的徒步团体写了社论谴责他们的计划，

sentences.en: saying it would hurt the cause for expanded access to the countryside.
sentences.zh: 称这会损害争取扩大乡村通行权的事业。

sentences.en: One editorial argued that trespassing was fine,
sentences.zh: 有一篇社论争辩说，擅自闯入本无不可，

sentences.en: but it should be done alone or with just one or two people,
sentences.zh: 但应该独自或者只和一两个人一起进行，
悄悄地、利落地、顺利地完成。

sentences.en: The police were well aware of the plans to trespass at Kinder Scout
sentences.zh: 警察对金德代因特山集体闯入的计划了如指掌，

sentences.en: and Benny Rothman's role in all of it.
sentences.zh: 也知道本尼·罗斯曼在其中扮演的角色。

sentences.en: And on the day of the event,
they tried to serve him with an injunction to keep him from going.
sentences.zh: 他们试图向他送达一项禁令以阻止他前往。

sentences.en: The police knew he was coming,
and they all expected him to come by train,
sentences.zh: 而他们所有人都以为他会坐火车来，

sentences.en: so they were kind of hanging out at the train station.
sentences.zh: 所以他们当时都在火车站附近晃悠。

sentences.en: Rothman makes it to the trespass
sentences.zh: 罗斯曼成功抵达了闯入地点，

sentences.en: and finds about 400 other people are there, too.
Mostly young people, below the age of 21.
A lot of men, but some women, too.
sentences.zh: 有很多男性，但也有一些女性。

sentences.en: This is kind of the standard hiking garb of the day.
sentences.zh: 这算是当时标准的远足行头了。
他们都背着这种巨大的背包。

sentences.en: They're considered, like, the thing to do at the time.
sentences.zh: 在当时，这被认为是很时髦的做法。

sentences.en: They quite often wore berets on their heads.
sentences.zh: 他们经常在头上戴着贝雷帽。

sentences.en: So it was a very, very motley crew, I think.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，这是一支非常、非常杂牌的队伍。
这支由远足者组成的杂牌队伍，

sentences.en: gathered with their berets and rucksacks
at the base of the mountain,
and Benny Rothman gave a speech
sentences.zh: 本尼·罗斯曼发表了一场演讲，

sentences.en: about taking back the rites they lost
sentences.zh: 内容是关于夺回他们在17和18世纪的圈地运动中，
